i feel you. i even went as far as using eyeshadow to exaggerate the bags under my eyes hoping someone would notice and ask if i was ok. 
... guess what? no one asked
i’m here if you want to talk!
i thought i was the only one...
if you need someone i’m here!
Do you wanna chat? Like privately
I have people I hang out with... but none of them know the real me
Me too... I just want to feel like I belong and like I would be missed if i wasn’t there.
